title: 第7章 初修仙法
content_zh:
跟张山、孙康、刘兰三人分别认识之后，李老道得知不能私斗，也只好暂且放下收拾韩榆的打算，又询问三人有关种植灵田的事情。

    张山三人瞧见李老道、韩榆两人一无所知，也多少给他们介绍了一下。

    李老道、韩榆见他们说话之间总是不自觉地瞧向王管事住所方向，显然王管事对他们这些杂役弟子态度恶劣，他们这些早来一步的人更有体会。

    稍作认识之后，张三、孙康、刘兰三人回了自己的石屋，李老道看一眼韩榆，冷哼一声：“明日把金师兄给的那玉简给我看！”

    韩榆默然点头，又问：“道爷，这黑老鸹……”

    “你愿意养就养吧，我要走修仙正途，不会再炼血了！”李老道说完之后，转身而去。

    韩榆目送李老道进了石屋，带着自己的衣服、玉简也进了自己的石屋，大乌鸦也飞起来跟着进了屋子。

    屋内有简单的一床一桌一椅，门口有小灶台和水缸水桶，被褥碗筷都没有。

    韩榆脱掉自己一身破烂衣服，耐心洗刷梳洗之后，在水缸里面照了照，见到了一双明亮的眼眸。

    对着水缸中的自己笑了笑，他换上杂役弟子的灰衣，找了找屋里面也没有什么吃食，便坐在床边拿起玉简贴在额头处。

    初时只感觉冰凉，渐渐凝神之后便感觉到玉简内容。

    “气如青禾生沃土，根深方得叶葳蕤，此为万春谷基础《练气诀》，又称《青禾练气心法》。”

    韩榆全神贯注，将练气诀的修炼方法弄明白便迫不及待开始尝试。

    然后过了半个时辰全无收获，这才不得不放弃，又看金琦师兄给的生活类常识。

    看过之后，又结合张山等人的描述，韩榆更加明白万春谷仙门内也并非任凭修炼、逍遥的地方。

    仙门内自有规矩，巡逻、炼器、炼丹、制符，外出斩妖、弟子大比每一项都有详细规定，按规矩可得“大功”“小功”，以大功、小功兑换宗门内功法、法器、丹药等各类物品，不按规矩则是要受罚，严重的甚至可能废掉修为，关押起来。

    包括看药园、种灵田，甚至管事、执事们也都有规矩。

    韩榆对其他方面粗略看两眼，只是把自己种灵田的规矩仔细看过，记在心里。

    这一通忙活过后，耳边忽然听到一阵“嘎嘎”声音。

    原来是大乌鸦又饿了。

    韩榆将带着骏马血气的小罐子打开，大乌鸦顿时欣喜地凑上前来，鸟喙探入其中啜饮。
content_en:
After getting to know Zhang Shan, Sun Kang, and Liu Lan respectively, Li Laodao learned that he could not fight privately, so he had to put aside his plan to deal with Han Yu for the time being, and asked the three people about planting spiritual fields.

Zhang Shan and the others saw that Li Laodao and Han Yu knew nothing about them, so they gave them a brief introduction.

Li Laodao and Han Yu saw that they were always looking in the direction of Manager Wang's residence unconsciously when they were talking. It was obvious that Manager Wang had a bad attitude towards them, the handyman disciples, and those of them who had come a step earlier knew better.

After getting to know each other for a while, Zhang San, Sun Kang, and Liu Lan returned to their stone houses. Li Laodao glanced at Han Yu and snorted: "Show me the jade slips given by Senior Brother Jin tomorrow!"

Han Yu nodded silently and asked again: "Master Dao, this black old bird..."

"You can raise her if you want. I want to follow the right path of cultivating immortality and will no longer refine blood!" After finishing speaking, Li Laodao turned around and left.

Han Yu watched Li Laodao enter the stone house, and took his clothes and jade slips into his stone house. The big crow also flew up and followed him into the house.

There is a simple bed, table and chairs in the house. There is a small stove, water tank and bucket at the door. There are no bedding, dishes or chopsticks.

Han Yu took off his tattered clothes, washed and freshened up patiently, took a photo in the water tank, and saw a pair of bright eyes.

Smiling at himself in the water tank, he put on the gray clothes of a handyman disciple. After searching the room, there was nothing to eat, so he sat by the bed, picked up the jade slip, and put it against his forehead.

At first I just felt cold, but after gradually concentrating, I felt the contents of the jade slip.

"Qi is like green grass growing in fertile soil, and only with deep roots can the leaves grow. This is the basis of Wanchun Valley's "Qi Lian Jue", also known as "Qing He Qi Lian Xin Jie".

Han Yu concentrated on it, figured out the method of Qi Lian Jue, and couldn't wait to try it.

Then after half an hour with no results, I had to give up and look at the life knowledge given by Senior Brother Jin Qi.

After reading it and combining it with the descriptions of Zhang Shan and others, Han Yu understood better that the Immortal Sect of Wanchun Valley was not a place where people could just practice and be free.

The Immortal Sect has its own rules, including patrolling, refining weapons, refining elixirs, making talismans, going out to slay monsters, and competing in disciple competitions. Each item has detailed regulations. According to the rules, you can obtain "great merit" and "minor merit". You can use the great merit and minor merit to exchange for various items such as the sect's internal skills, magic tools, elixirs, etc. If you don't follow the rules, you will be punished. In serious cases, your cultivation may be revoked and you may be imprisoned.

Including taking care of medicine gardens, planting spiritual fields, and even stewards and deacons have rules.

Han Yu took a cursory look at other aspects, but carefully read the rules of his spiritual field and kept them in mind.

After this busy work, I suddenly heard a "quacking" sound in my ears.

It turned out that the big crow was hungry again.

Han Yu opened the small jar containing the blood of the horse, and the big crow came forward with joy and put its beak into it to take a sip.
